name: Neptune
hook: The blue ice giant found by mathematics — sea god, rings, Triton and the Kuiper Belt beyond.

facts.label: its 1846 discovery
facts.statement: Neptune was found in 1846 by Johann Galle after Le Verrier and Adams predicted it mathematically; the French wanted to call it Le Verrier.

facts.label: Poseidon
facts.statement: Neptune is the Roman sea god; the Greeks called him Poseidon, and he is usually shown wielding a trident.

facts.label: Triton
facts.statement: Triton, Neptune's largest moon, is named for a son of Poseidon and has a strange retrograde orbit.

facts.label: its rings
facts.statement: Neptune has rings made mainly of dust, including ones named Le Verrier and Adams; only Saturn's rings are visible through a small telescope.

facts.label: the Kuiper Belt
facts.statement: Beyond Neptune's orbit lies the Kuiper Belt, the icy belt of Pluto and many short-period comets.

facts.label: one Neptunian year
facts.statement: Neptune's orbit is so vast that in July 2011 it completed its first full orbit since its discovery in 1846.

facts.label: Pisces
facts.statement: Neptune is one of the two planets said to rule Pisces, the fish sign of the zodiac.
